chunks: 4405 - Al-Sadiq عليه السلام said to some of his companions:

When your wife is brought to you, take hold of her forelock, face her toward the qiblah, and say: “O Allah, by Your trust I have taken her, and by Your words I have made her private part lawful for myself. So if You decree for me from her a child, then make him blessed and sound, and do not make for Shaytan in him any share or portion.”

key_terms.أَهْلُكَ: your wife or household here, referring to the bride brought to the husband
key_terms.الْقِبْلَةَ: the qiblah, the direction faced in devotion
key_terms.بِأَمَانَتِكَ: by Your trust; acknowledging the wife as a trust from Allah
key_terms.بِكَلِمَاتِكَ: by Your words; referring to the divine basis by which marriage is lawful
key_terms.بِنَاصِيَتِهَا: by her forelock; a physical gesture mentioned in the supplication’s etiquette
key_terms.شِرْكًا: a share or participation; here meaning a portion for Shaytan in the child

ai.seo_question: What should a man say when his wife is brought to him according to Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith teaches a supplication and etiquette to be observed when a man’s wife is brought to him. It expresses that the marriage bond is entered under Allah’s trust and seeks a blessed, sound child protected from Shaytan’s share.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4405 - Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as), said to some of his companions:

"When your wife is brought to you, take hold of her forelock, face her toward the Qibla, and say: 'O Allah (swt), I have taken her with Your (swt) trust, and by Your (swt) words, I have made her lawful for myself. If You (swt) decree for me from her a child, then make him blessed, righteous, and sound, and do not allow Satan to have any share or portion in him.'"
